query: Help me understand what's worth analyzing in these incident tickets.

per_column.name: Is_Critical
per_column.rationale: A criticality flag is a reasonable axis for triage analysis, and the table has a 'priority' column that could ground it. However, the distribution is heavily skewed (424 of 500 = 1), making it near-constant and low-leverage. The evidence samples reveal groundedness problems: 'Printer not working properly' and routine printer issues are labeled Is_Critical=1, which is not warranted by the source text and appears to contradict any sensible criticality reading. All five samples are '1', consistent with an over-asserting, poorly grounded flag.

per_column.name: Resolution_Speed
per_column.rationale: Bucketing resolution time is genuinely useful for analyzing incident handling and gives a real axis to compare on. But the source evidence undermines the values badly: in every sample, sys_updated_on equals closed_at to the same timestamp, implying a resolution duration of effectively zero, yet rows are labeled 'Medium (4-10 days)', 'Slow (>10 days)', and 'Fast (≤3 days)'. The bucket assignments are not derivable from (and contradict) the timestamps shown, indicating fabricated durations.

per_column.name: Is_Printer_Related
per_column.rationale: A printer-related flag is a plausible, well-balanced (298/202) categorical axis for grouping incidents by theme, useful for this exploratory query. Values are soundly derived from short_description: printer descriptions map to 1, connectivity/database map to 0. Well grounded across all samples.

judge.rationale: The added columns propose reasonable analytical axes (criticality, resolution speed, printer theme) that would help exploratory triage of incident tickets, so usefulness is moderate-to-good, though Is_Critical is weakened by a near-constant skew. Groundedness is the main failure: Resolution_Speed contradicts the source timestamps (updated=closed implies ~0 duration yet varied speed buckets are assigned), and Is_Critical over-asserts criticality on routine printer tickets without textual support. Only Is_Printer_Related is reliably grounded.
